title: Cryptographic weakness detection runner: weak key lengths, deprecated algorithms, TLS/SSH config, and captured traffic analysis
goal: AutoPenBench's Cryptography tasks (CRPT) had 0% autonomous success and 25% assisted success — the hardest category. AegisPT's ssl-tls runner covers basic certificate checks but misses deeper cryptographic weaknesses. Implement a crypto-audit runner: (1) TLS/SSL deep audit: Beyond ssl-tls, check for: export-grade ciphers (FREAK, DROWN), BEAST attack (CBC mode in TLS 1.0), LUCKY13, POODLE (SSLv3), RC4 usage, weak DH parameters (<2048 bits), TLS 1.0/1.1 still enabled, HSTS preload missing, certificate key length <2048 bits. Use testssl.sh for comprehensive checks. (2) SSH cryptographic audit: ssh-audit checks for: deprecated key exchange algorithms (diffie-hellman-group1-sha1, diffie-hellman-group14-sha1), weak MACs (hmac-md5, hmac-sha1-96), deprecated host key algorithms (DSA). (3) JWE/JWS weak algorithms: detect applications using RSA-PKCS1v15 for JWT signing (vs RSA-PSS), none algorithm acceptance (already in backlog-221), HS256 with short key. (4) API password hashing: detect if password reset tokens or session tokens use MD5/SHA1 (via length analysis of tokens in responses — 32 chars hex = MD5). (5) Heartbleed-style OpenSSL: CVE-2014-0160 — already testable via Nuclei template. (6) Knowledge base: link each finding to an explanation of why the algorithm is weak and what the correct alternative is. Passive + active tier.
scope: AutoPenBench CRPT tasks: 0% autonomous SR. ssl-tls runner exists but is basic. Enterprise crypto audits require testssl.sh depth. Known-plaintext and DH brute-force from AutoPenBench are advanced cryptographic attacks beyond typical web pentest scope.
generation_reason: AutoPenBench CRPT 0% success shows this is hard. AegisPT ssl-tls is basic. testssl.sh + ssh-audit adds enterprise-grade crypto analysis without requiring novel cryptographic attack capabilities.

constraints.active_task_gate: Do not implement until this package is the single active task in NEXT_TASK.md.
constraints.scope_creep_guard: Configuration and algorithm detection only. No brute-force attacks on live encryption. No decryption attempts.

success_criteria: crypto-audit runner runs testssl.sh against HTTPS targets.
Export-grade cipher, POODLE, BEAST findings produced where applicable.
Findings include fix recommendation with correct algorithm.
Passive tier for TLS fingerprinting, active for full testssl.sh.
No regression in ssl-tls runner or existing tests.
